name: Reedmere
title: Broad hand-ink headlines
description: A broad, heavy hand-ink display face with blunt nib endings, softly squared bowls and an uneven written rhythm. Suited to expressive headlines, packaging and identity lettering.
story: Papyrus supplies the calligraphic and material ancestry. The selected current A raster, after its uppercase I whole-sheet correction, takes a broader and bolder direction. Its 52 letters were traced with protected counters and components; recorded cleanup, optical spacing and authored Latin companions turn the selected drawing into a usable display font. The whole-sheet edit and its collateral changes remain disclosed.
independent_review: Current final package cleared in integration handoff
distribution_terms: Pending owner review. No redistribution license is assigned to these sample font assets. The repository compiler license is unchanged.
build_boundary: Documented project-local compatibility adapter runs the pinned Fontify compiler and gated review; plain JSON CLI cannot directly admit blank NBSP/zero-advance marks. Producer source-stage, compiled and release records are distinct from the integration binary checks.
limitations: Display use from 48px; body text and smaller sizes are not certified.
Exact listed coverage and documented language/one- or two-mark samples only. Arbitrary accent stacks, every Latin orthography and every rendering engine are not certified.
Static Regular TTF/WOFF2 only; no CFF OTF, variable axes or additional styles.
Monochrome outlines retain edge personality, not grayscale ink shading.
56 explicit core kerning pairs; extended spacing is reviewed without an exhaustive extended-pair claim.
